_comment: Mutation testing: break the code on purpose, check whether a test notices. A SURVIVED mutant is a line nothing is watching — the test that claimed to cover it cannot fail. This is the automated form of the manual check that found ~10 live bugs hiding behind green suites on 2026-08-04/05. See AGENTS.md 'Test discipline'.
_mutate_comment: ONLY modules whose behaviour is pinned by DB-FREE tests (vitest.mutation.config.ts). A module tested solely through the live-DB suites would report false survivors here and teach everyone to ignore the report. Grow this list when a module gains DB-free coverage; do not grow it to chase a number.
_workspace_caveat: packages/music-rules is DELIBERATELY absent. npm workspaces symlink it into node_modules, and Stryker's sandbox resolves that symlink back to the REAL file — so it mutates a copy nothing loads and reports 0%/all-no-coverage for code tests/music.test.ts genuinely covers. A knowingly false number teaches everyone to ignore the report, so the module is excluded until the resolution is fixed; its rules stay pinned by music.test.ts and the TS-vs-SQL mirror test. packages/site-bridge is absent for the SAME reason — its cursor/styles/frame rules stay pinned by the site-bridge-*.test.ts suites.
_thresholds_comment: break is a RATCHET, not a target: raise it as the score rises, never lower it to make a red build green. A drop means a new line went unwatched or an existing test stopped biting — that is the report doing its job. First honest baseline was 70.7% (2026-08-05); 72.59% on 2026-08-10 after link-vocabulary.ts and panel-inputs.ts joined the slice, so break moves to 70; the aggregate is dragged down by the DB-backed halves of song-merge.ts and storage-gc.ts, whose lines no DB-free test executes (Stryker counts those as no-coverage). 2026-09-03: artist-facts.ts and seo-audit.ts joined the slice (they were pure with DB-free tests and unwatched — the omission AGENTS.md names). A targeted run over just those two: artist-facts.ts 93.55%, seo-audit.ts 62.55%, and they add 282 of the slice's 5302 mutants, so the aggregate moves ~0.3pp — break stays 70, and seo-audit.ts's 68 survivors are the work, not the threshold. The per-file survivor list is the actionable output, not this number. high/low only colour the HTML report. NOTE the workspace caveat below no longer says "packages/site-bridge is absent": one module from it is now here, and it is only safe because its test imports the module by RELATIVE path — importing through the @samfox1/site-bridge symlink reports the whole file as no-coverage. Any further packages/ module must do the same. 2026-09-11: event/derive.ts + _shared/{hash,request,cors}.ts joined (derive.ts 93% targeted); ratchet `break` after the next full sweep, not from memory. 2026-09-12: site-bridge/analytics.ts joined — the first packages/ module in the slice; it is the one way every site reports a fan action, and it is DB-free tested. Also 2026-09-12: src/lib/analytics.ts and src/lib/format.ts joined. analytics.ts arrived with a full DB-free test file and was missed by the commit that added it; format.ts had NO tests at all and was quietly wrong — seriesTrend compared 3 days against 4 on an odd-length series, so every flat 7-day window read +33.3%. Both are the omission AGENTS.md names: a module not on this list is never looked at. Targeted scores on joining: format.ts 97.37% (the 2 survivors left are equivalent mutants, named in its test file); analytics.ts 75.45% overall but 93.26% of COVERED mutants — the gap is analyticsByEntity's DB path, which no DB-free test executes, the same shape as song-merge.ts and storage-gc.ts above. 2026-09-13: src/lib/connections.ts joined at 87.17% (Links + Sources became one Connections tool; the model that derives the list from both registries is pure). Its 27 survivors are trim()/optional-chaining/sort-option equivalents plus two unreachable `?? ''` fallbacks; the reachable ones were closed the same day. Same day, src/lib/settings.ts joined (the Settings rows + the enquiries state line; DB-free tested). 2026-09-15: packages/site-bridge/mirror.ts joined — the temporary PostHog cross-check, DB-free tested, imported by RELATIVE path like analytics.ts above. It arrived at 69.30% (below break) and the run paid for itself immediately: it found a real bug — a script that loads but defines nothing set `ready` anyway and captured every later click into a no-op — plus a test that could not fail, an SSR guard fed `{ document: undefined }`, which falls through the `??` to the REAL global. Both fixed; an `error` listener and a `doc.documentElement` fallback were DELETED rather than tested, because their survivors were telling the truth: neither line changed anything observable. Now 88.79%, and its 13 remaining survivors are equivalent mutants enumerated at the top of tests/unit/analytics/site-bridge-mirror.test.ts. This module is meant to be deleted when the comparison passes; remove it from this list then. 2026-09-17: src/lib/compare-posthog.ts joined — the judge behind `npm run compare:posthog` (ratio band, low-n gate, PostHog-only click gate, referrer normalization, no-data exit 2). Pure and DB-free tested; its equivalent survivors are listed at the top of tests/unit/analytics/compare-posthog.test.ts. Delete it with mirror.ts when the comparison passes.
